nonIntegerAtomicNumbers.conclusion: Fractional Z is possible in parser intermediates and direct low-level API calls, but supported live-app load/edit/session paths normalize or reject it before the three symbol callers. Fractional lookup divergences are unreachable in ordinary live structures, not universally unreachable API branches.
liveAppGuards: file-loader.js appendParsedVolumeRecord calls app ensureVolumeSchema before storing a volume
structure.js ensureVolumeSchema normalizes every atom before invoking inferBonds; normalizeVolumeAtom uses Number(atom.Z)|0
XYZ resolves symbols against the bundled integer table; Molden uses parseInt; editor/Coordinates use integer selection or Math.trunc
structure-envelope import invokes ensureVolumeSchema; session-format validates safe integer Z in [1,118] before hydration

reachableUnknownElement.note: Covalent radii read metadata by Z; metal classification/radii/coordination caps use symbol-keyed tables. A placeholder alone would still choose generic chemistry defaults; validation/error propagation is required.

knownOutOfScopeClamp.note: Known separate finite-number/fallback contract; deliberately excluded from Stage 1 and future Stage 4/5 duplicate rediscovery.
